jobs.employer_name: Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL Niederlassung Deutschland
jobs.description:
Would you like to own driving revenue and customer engagements for a leader in the Cloud Computing business? Would you like to be part of a team focused on increasing awareness and adoption of Amazon Web Services by engaging with Public Sector organizations in Germany who are reinventing their IT strategy by adopting cloud computing? Do you have the business savvy, sales experience, and technical background necessary to help further establish Amazon as a leading cloud platform provider?

As a Greenfield Account Executive within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Worldwide Public Sector (WWPS), you will build AWS adoption in net-new public sector accounts with limited or no existing AWS presence. You will own the full sales cycle, from prospecting through close, helping public sector organizations reinvent their IT strategy through cloud computing.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in full sales cycle, technology sales, sales engineering/consulting or equivalent business development
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience
- Experience using sales CRM tools such as Salesforce
- Fluent in German and English with the ability to conduct sales and technical conversations with customers in both languages
- Experience developing and executing sales strategies, tactics, plans, processes, systems and programs
- Experience in generating new opportunities with strong focus on pipeline tracking and deal execution through entire sales cycle

Preferred qualifications

- AWS Associate level certification, or Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
- Experience with government procurement and contracting process
- Experience working with partners through account, product or program management and business development engagements
- Experience selling nascent products and services Ability to drive solutions to difficult problems
- Experience driving new business in greenfield accounts at the C-suite level or equivalent
- Experience in strategic thinking about business, enterprise software products, and new technology platforms and architectures or equivalent

This role requires building a sales function from the ground up, demanding creative problem-solving, tenacity, and the ability to develop novel approaches for reaching and engaging prospective customers. You will establish business and technical relationships with public sector organizations, driving adoption of AWS services that transform how they deliver services to citizens and communities.

You will engage customers face-to-face and via teleconference, interacting at the CXO level in strategic accounts. The ideal candidate possesses both business acumen to drive executive-level engagements and technical knowledge to interact effectively with software developers and architects.

This position requires working from the local office when not at customer sites.

Key job responsibilities
Sales Execution
• Prospect and qualify net-new public sector accounts with limited or no AWS presence
• Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through close
• Meet or exceed quarterly revenue targets while maintaining robust pipeline coverage
• Maintain accurate sales forecasts and pipeline reporting in Salesforce

Customer Engagement
• Develop and execute territory plans to maximize market penetration
• Translate cloud and AI capabilities into mission-relevant use cases for public sector organizations
• Build relationships across customer organizations, including C-level executives, engineering, IT/operations, and procurement
• Conduct discovery calls to understand agency missions and technical challenges

Public Sector Expertise
• Navigate public sector procurement processes including RFPs, cooperative contracts, and federal/state/local contract vehicles
• Apply knowledge of public sector compliance requirements, certifications, and fiscal year buying cycles
• Structure deals that meet public sector regulatory, compliance, and grant-funded operating requirements

Collaboration
• Partner with solutions architects and internal stakeholders to accelerate deal velocity
• Collaborate with the partner ecosystem (systems integrators, resellers, distributors) to drive customer success and extend market reach
• Use data and insights to prioritize outreach and identify high-potential prospects

A day in the life
You will balance hunting new accounts with nurturing early-stage relationships. Working with a team of German AE's to grow the Public Sector Greenfield business. You will spend time on prospecting, researching accounts, sourcing contacts, and executing outbound campaigns to generate meetings. You will conduct discovery calls to understand agency missions and technical challenges, navigate complex procurement processes, and coordinate with Legal, Contracts, and partner teams. You will maintain your pipeline in Salesforce and forecast accurately. This role requires strategic thinking and tactical execution, with autonomy to innovate your approach to breaking into new accounts.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

jobs.occupation: DCO Manager (Facility-Manager/in)
jobs.employer_name: Amazon Data Services European Sovereign Cloud GmbH
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for a Data Center Operations Manager to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team in our site in Berlin.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

We are currently expanding our infrastructure management team and we are looking for a manager with experience in people leadership, a strong technical understanding of data center operations and infrastructure, and the drive and vision to take AWS Data Center Operations into the future.

The Data Center Manager is the leadership role for our compute operations teams within an AWS region. They will have managerial responsibility for safety, security, availability, scaling, costs and efficiency for their department. They lead the team that is installing, maintaining, and de-commissioning network and server equipment in a safe, secure and cost-effective manner across the region. The Data Center Operations Manager must manage across each function but also have the ability to dive deep into any given function as needed.

Key job responsibilities
Lead and supervise a team of Data Center Technicians which is installing, maintaining and decommissioning network and server hardware

- Oversee the safety, security, availability, quality, and performance of the team, while driving a positive customer experience
- Strategic planning and forecasting; manage team and individual performance; delivering performance reviews, and address staffing needs
- Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and procedures
- Mentor, train and develop career progression for direct reports and members of the organization
- Coordinate the shift work among the team and ensure 24 hours coverage available for our data centers
- Maintant on-call duties
- Obsess over team learning and development, both from a technical/functional and soft skills (critical thinking, emotional intelligence, and adaptability) development perspective
- Coordinate support of change management resources in partnership with electrical and mechanical operations teams
- Develop, improve, and share operational best practices across the region and with peers globally

About the team
Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career growth
We have a career path for you no matter what stage you’re in when you start here. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of data center infrastructure design, operations, or delivery
- Experience using English communication skills, both written and verbal, to foster seamless interaction with stakeholders at all levels
- 2+ years of experience as a people manager in a technical environment, preferably managing operational teams in a 24x7 environment.
- Experience with change management and fault management processes.
- This role requires you to be a national of an EU member state.

Preferred qualifications

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. jobs.occupation: 588035 Factory Project Manager (all genders) (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
As Project Manager BBN Factory, you will join the production and operations network of Philips' HPM manufacturing site in Böblingen and work closely with PIE, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Facility Management and the shop floor. In this high-impact role, you will translate strategic industrialization objectives into operational execution, ensuring the successful and timely introduction of new products in an international environment. As a central coordinator between local and global stakeholders, you will directly contribute to the sustainable development and future readiness of the Böblingen site.

You will take end-to-end ownership of complex, production-related projects within the BBN Factory environment, ensuring on-time industrialization and new-product introduction. Acting as the key interface between Product Industrialization Engineering (PIE), Production Process Engineering, the shop floor and other Operations functions, you will coordinate production-line setups, machinery and system implementations, and cross-site initiatives—playing a decisive role in achieving critical NPI milestones.

This is an opportunity to shape how innovative patient-monitoring solutions move from industrialization into reliable production, influence a broad international stakeholder network and leave a visible, lasting impact on Philips' global manufacturing organization.

Please note: This is a fixed-term employment contract for 24 months.

Your Role:

- Job title:End-to-End Project Management: Plan, manage and execute multiple parallel production and industrialization projects in a manufacturing environment, including schedule, resource, cost and risk management.
- Interface & Stakeholder Management: Closely coordinate between PIE, Production Process Engineering, the shop floor, Facility Management, material supply, logistics, Production Management and operator resource management.
- QMS & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and Quality Management System processes, particularly in the medical-technology environment, and create, maintain and secure approval of relevant production-side project and process documentation.
- Supplier & Partner Management: Manage relevant internal and external project partners and work closely with Calibration, Maintenance and Technical Support teams.
- International Project Coordination: Lead and coordinate international projects across multiple HPM locations, particularly programs involving several sites within a global matrix organization.

You're the right fit if:

- You have a bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, industrial management, or a related field.
- You have at least 5 years of experience leading manufacturing or industrialization projects across multiple workstreams.
- You have experience with quality systems and compliance in a regulated sector.
- You have practical knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, and structured project management.
- You have experience coordinating global, cross-functional teams.
- You understand production processes, equipment, robotics, and NPI.
- You are able to influence without authority and drive actions.
- You have business-level German and fluent English, both spoken and written.
- You are able to deliver NPI, quality, and production-readiness milestones.
- You collaborate effectively across factory and operational functions.

Benefits include:

- Annual leave: 30 days
- Mobility and devices: subsidized Germany ticket, leasing opportunities for private use (bicycles, cars, smartphones,…)
- Philips University & Philips in Balance: Wide range of professional training courses and for personal development & Healthcare
- Philips Pension Fund: Employer-funded pension plan
- Philips "Partnerzeit": two paid weeks off after your partner has given birth
- Philips MyShop: Discount on Philips products
- Culture: Informal culture, a paid day for voluntary work, various team/cultural activities (on sustainability, diversity, ...), etc.

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is €103,510.62 – €138,014.16. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations.

This role is eligible for Short Term Incentive, with your rewards linked to individual performance and company results. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision.

How we work together
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.

About Philips
Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? jobs.occupation: UX/UI Design Lead (m/f/d) (UX-Designer/in)
jobs.description:
BIRKENSTOCK is a global brand which embraces all consumers regardless of geography, gender, age and income. The company is deeply footed on a family tradition of shoemaking that can be traced back to 1774. With around 7100 employees worldwide, BIRKENSTOCK is the largest employer in the German footwear industry. To ensure our quality standards, we produce over 95% of our products in Germany and source more than 90% of our materials and components from Europe. The BIRKENSTOCK Group is headquartered in Linz am Rhein and maintains several locations in Germany, as well as sales offices in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia.

Join us in shaping the future at our location in München as a

UX/UI Design Lead (m/f/d)

YOUR SHOES TO FILL:

- Lead the end-to-end UX/UI design process for BIRKENSTOCK's digital products and e-commerce experiences, from discovery and concept validation through wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs. Conduct and support user research activities such as usability testing, surveys, card sorting, or onsite analyses, translating customer insights into measurable product improvements and seamless user journeys.
- Champion a customer-centric design culture by advocating for user needs throughout the product development lifecycle. Partner closely with Product Managers, Development, and QA teams to shape product vision, participate in roadmap discussions, align design solutions with business goals and technical constraints, and ensure accurate implementation of design concepts.
- Own and continuously evolve the BIRKENSTOCK design system, component library, UI standards, and reusable design patterns, ensuring consistency, scalability, accessibility, and usability across platforms, regions, and customer touchpoints. Drive quality assurance for UX and UI execution and maintain design governance and best practices.
- Act as UX/UI expert and primary point of contact within the organization, guiding and sparring with team members, prioritizing projects and workload, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing, and helping build a high-performing, feedback-driven design culture.
- Stay at the forefront of UX, UI, accessibility, and emerging technologies, continuously identifying opportunities to enhance the customer experience. Promote and enable the responsible use of AI across the design process, including research synthesis, ideation, content creation, prototyping, workflow optimization, and overall design efficiency.

YOUR WALK OF LIFE:

- 8+ years of professional experience in UX/UI Design, including experience in a Senior, Lead, or comparable role, with a strong portfolio demonstrating expertise across the full product design lifecycle.
- Proven experience designing customer-centric digital products and complex user journeys, ideally within e-commerce, retail, fashion, or lifestyle environments.
- Strong expertise in User Research, User Testing, Interaction Design, Information Architecture, Visual Design, Design Systems, Accessibility, and Design Thinking methodologies.
- Advanced proficiency in Figma and modern design tools, with experience working in Agile product environments and collaborating through tools such as Jira and Confluence.
- Strong understanding of design system management, UX/UI governance, usability principles, accessibility standards, and scalable UI frameworks. Experience maintaining design guidelines, knowledge bases, and reusable design patterns that enable consistent user experiences across international markets and digital touchpoints.
- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, , and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to present design and UX recommendations, form strategic decisions, and articulate design rationale at all levels of the organization.
- Demonstrated experience coaching, mentoring, and supporting designers, fostering a collaborative and feedback-driven team culture, while helping prioritize workloads and balance project assignments to achieve business objectives.
- Curiosity and openness toward AI, emerging technologies, and innovative design practices, with the ability to evaluate and introduce tools that enhance team productivity and customer outcomes. Passion for staying ahead of UX, UI, accessibility, and AI trends and translating best practices into continuous improvements across the digital customer experience.
- A detail-oriented, hands-on problem solver with a continuous improvement mindset, adaptability in fast-paced environments, and a strong strategic execution approach that balances customer needs, business objectives, and technical feasibility.
- Fluent English is required; German language skills are a plus

WE OFFER:

BIRKENSTOCK offers you all the advantages of a successful, fast growing, global company: dynamic work environment, considerable design freedom, authentic and open corporate culture and excellent development opportunities.

Sounds exciting? It is. Our Talent Acquisition team is looking forward to receiving your online application!

Please hand in your application in English.

jobs.occupation: Staff Network Reliability Engineer (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Informations-, Kommunikationstechnik)
jobs.description:
NRE Operations runs the data center networks for the entire IONOS group: the physical fabric and underlay, the SDN overlay, and the virtual network functions on top, across dozens of data centers. We are looking for a senior or staff-level engineer who operates large production networks with a reliability mindset. You define what "healthy" means, catch problems before customers do, lead the hardest incidents, and partner with NRE Automation to push routine operations toward zero manual steps. AI is central to how we work, both to make the network smarter and to make each engineer faster.

We expect every engineer here to be fluent with AI, and we mean it in two concrete ways. First, applying AI to the network itself: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis and root-cause analysis, config generation and validation, smarter alerting, and runbook or agent-driven automation. Second, using AI to raise your own output: coding assistants and LLM tooling for scripting, troubleshooting, research, and documentation. Reliability work punishes blind trust, so the skill that matters most is judgment. You need to know when an AI-generated config or diagnosis is trustworthy and when it is not.

Tasks

- Own reliability of the physical fabric, SDN overlay, and virtual network functions across all IONOS data centers. Set service level objectives and drive down unplanned downtime.
- Lead incident response on major network incidents and run postmortems that produce lasting fixes.
- Remove toil through automation, working with NRE Automation on pipelines and tooling for lifecycle, patching, and service configuration.
- Apply AI to operations: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis, config generation and validation, and automated remediation, with the judgment to know when AI output is trustworthy.
- Strengthen observability so problems surface before they reach customers, and shape lifecycle, upgrade, change-management, and capacity practices.
- Collaborate with NRE Provisioning on clean handovers.
- Share the on-call rotation covering the above.

Qualifications

- Extensive hands-on experience operating large-scale production data center networks (5+ years for Senior, longer for Staff).
- Deep Layer 2 and Layer 3 knowledge: routing (BGP, OSPF) and VXLAN with BGP/EVPN.
- Multi-vendor operations across Juniper and Cisco; SONiC and Netbox familiarity is a plus.
- Strong Linux fundamentals and the toolkit that goes with them (bash, tcpdump, iptables, git).
- Network automation you have built, using Python with Ansible and CI/CD on GitLab.
- A reliability-engineering mindset: SLOs, observability, incident command, postmortems, designing out toil.
- Fluent, critical use of AI in daily engineering, plus a track record or credible ideas for applying AI to network operations.
- Fluent English for international teams; German is a plus. Ownership and a calm approach when things break.

Benefits

- Hybrid working model.
- Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.
- At some locations a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.
- Modern office space with very good transport connections.
- Various employee discounts for activities and products.
- Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.
- Numerous training and development opportunities.
- Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.

jobs.occupation: vEFK - Verantwortliche Elektrofachkraft / Qualified Electrician (m/f/d) (Elektrofachkraft für festgelegte Tätigkeiten)
jobs.description:
TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

We are seeking an experienced **vEFK (Electrical Safety Manager)** to take on formal electrical safety responsibility for our drone production facility, in accordance with DGUV Vorschrift 3 and DIN VDE 0105-100. As vEFK, you will be the designated person accountable for the safe operation, maintenance, and modification of all electrical systems and equipment across production lines, test benches, and facility infrastructure.

Your Road Map To Make an Impact

- Assume formal responsibility (per §13 DGUV V3 / VDE 0105) for electrical safety across the production facility, including assembly lines, battery test/charging stations, RF and avionics test benches, and building electrical systems
- Issue, review, and sign off on electrical work permits and switching authorizations
- Conduct and document risk assessments for electrical work (live working, lockout/tagout, isolation procedures)
- Supervise and coordinate Elektrofachkräfte (EFK) and elektrotechnisch unterwiesene Personen (EuP) on site
- Oversee inspection and testing of electrical equipment, machinery, and battery/charging infrastructure (per DGUV V3, VDE 0701-0702, and applicable Li-ion battery handling standards)
- Manage compliance with low-voltage directive, EMC requirements, and relevant drone/UAV manufacturing electrical safety standards
- Investigate electrical incidents, near-misses, and non-conformances; drive corrective actions
- Maintain documentation: circuit diagrams, inspection logs, training records, and safety instructions (Betriebsanweisungen)
- Liaise with quality, EHS, and engineering teams on electrical aspects of new production line rollouts and equipment procurement
- Train and qualify personnel on electrical safety procedures specific to drone assembly (e.g., high-density battery packs, motor/ESC testing, RF equipment)

Job requirements

- Completed vocational/technical training as Elektroniker, Elektroinstallateur, or equivalent, plus further qualification enabling appointment as vEFK (e.g., Meister, Techniker, or Ingenieur in Elektrotechnik)
- Formal written appointment eligibility as vEFK per employer's organizational delegation (Unternehmerpflichtenübertragung)
- Several years of hands-on experience in industrial electrical systems, ideally in manufacturing/production environments
- Sound knowledge of DGUV Vorschrift 3, VDE 0100/0105, VDE 0701-0702, and low-voltage directive requirements
- Experience with battery systems (Li-Po/Li-ion) and their associated electrical hazards is highly desirable given the UAV/drone context
- Strong documentation discipline and ability to train/supervise other electrical personnel
- Fluent German (technical/regulatory) and good working English (for international engineering teams)

Preferred / Nice to Have

- Experience in aerospace, UAV, or electronics/precision manufacturing
- Familiarity with ESD-sensitive component handling
- Knowledge of RF/EMC testing environments
- Experience with automated or semi-automated production line electrical systems

Why TYTAN?

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security
- Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale
- Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors
- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback
- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact
- Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company
- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation
- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit
- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us
- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team
- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together
- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands
- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

jobs.description:
The Leibniz Institute for Agricultural Engineering and Bioeconomy (ATB) is a pioneer and a driver of bioeconomy research. We create the scientific foundation to transform agricultural, food, industrial and energy systems into a sustainable bio-based circular economy. We develop and integrate techniques, processes and management strategies, effectively converging technologies to intelligently crosslink highly diverse bioeconomic production systems and to control them in a knowledge-based, adaptive and largely automated manner. We conduct research in dialogue with society, policymakers, industry and other stakeholders - knowledge-driven and application-inspired.

Within the EU-funded research project "MEDSoil+: Excellence in Mediterranean Soil Regeneration", the Mediterranean Institute for Agriculture, Environment and Development (MED) of the University of Évora (UE, Portugal) will be positioned as the first fully accredited soil lab infrastructure in Portugal capable of generating high-quality, standardised and interoperable soil monitoring data, by training, co-designing innovation, demonstrating and disseminating breakthrough knowledge through Living Labs (LL). The ATB will accompany and consult this process and will be particularly responsible for establishing proximal & remote sensing and IoT solutions for connected soil health mapping and monitoring. For this task, we are looking for the following person from 1 January 2027

Scientist (m/f/d) (100%)

Yourtasks

- Utilise proximal and remote sensing technologies to generate high-spatial-resolution soil property maps
- Deploy IoT and remote sensing technologies to establish a soil health monitoring system delivering high-temporal-resolution data streams
- Establish a federated soil data platform combining decentralised data access and governance with a secure central repository, integrating scientific data, sensor outputs and local knowledge to support soil intelligence, research and policymaking
- Develop robust AI and machine-learning algorithms for soil data fusion, predictive analytics, uncertainty quantification and scenario modelling
- Co-design, adapt and integrate user-oriented decision support systems (DSS) that translate soil intelligence, predictive uncertainty and AI-driven analytics into actionable and reliable recommendations for farmers, land managers and landowners

Your qualifications

- Very good university degree (Master/Diploma) and ideally a PhD with focus in soil science and data science
- Very good knowledge and experience in sensor-based soil mapping and DSS
- Very good knowledge and experience in optical spectroscopy, sensor calibration and data science
- Very good programming skills (R, Python)
- Knowledge in agriculture, soil science, proximal and remote sensing and geographic information systems
- Very good written and spoken English and good knowledge of German
- Independent work, high personal commitment, reliability, flexibility, ability to work in a team and willingness to cooperate are required
- Experience in writing articles for scientific journals and publication record in the above research fields
- Willingness to present project results at international conferences
- Willingness to travel into other EU countries
- Confident use of MS Office programs
- EU driving license class B

We offer

- An attractive, research-intensive and interdisciplinary working environment
- A varied position at the interface of science and practice
- Excellent infrastructure for scientific work
- Training and further education opportunities
- Family-friendly working conditions to promote work-life balance
- Participation in the VBB company ticket or Deutschlandticket
- A workplace at the edge of a picturesque landscape, easily accessible by bike or public transport

The full-time position (40 hours/week) is limited to six years. Part-time employment is also possible if desired. Salary will be based on your qualifications and experience according to TV-L up to pay grade 13.

For further information, please contact Dr. Sebastian Vogel (E-Mail: svogel@atb-potsdam.de) and visit our website at www.atb-potsdam.de (http://www.atb-potsdam.de) .

Summary

Apple's Hardware Program Management organization is looking for a Program Manager to lead PMIC silicon validation hardware programs end-to-end—from initial board design through factory builds, field deployment, and ongoing support for our validation engineers. This is an individual contributor role on a high-caliber Senior Program Management team whose mission is to deliver power management silicon on schedule. You will be embedded in the heartbeat of Apple's chip development process, driving the validation hardware programs that enable our advanced PMICs to go from first bring-up to production release. In this role, you will coordinate all aspects of hardware development, including requirements definition, design, implementation, and resolving complex technical issues. To be successful, you will need a strong technical background in board design, HW/SW integration, and ideally, project management experience in system board design or FPGA development. A proven track record in a dynamic engineering environment, along with exceptional multitasking and real-time crisis management skills, are essential for this position.

Description

• Coordinate development hardware requirements from multi-functional teams • Track project schedule for all development phases to ensure HW development schedules are met • Run development hardware builds, craft and manage build matrix for hardware configurations, • manage the factory teams to meet build objectives. Drive allocation requests and distribution of hardware with those multi-functional teams • Support development hardware needs for product and IC design teams • Engage with operations team to drive material delivery for builds • Drive resolution of technical issues between multi-functional teams • Convert large amounts of data into a clear story to communicate to organizations at all levels • Identify risks, develop mitigation strategies and facilitate conflict resolution • Focused issue reporting and communication of program risks and status • Technical understanding of system design and silicon validation planning

Responsibilities

Minimum Qualifications

- BS in electrical engineer or related engineering degree
- 3 year’s experience in hardware design and/or project management
- Fluency in English

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years experience in project or program management, preferably within a hardware, semiconductor, silicon validation, or systems engineering environment.
- Foundational understanding of hardware development and the board design lifecycle, from concept and specification through schematic review, fabrication, bring-up, and production.
- Ability to manage complex, multi-functional programs with aggressive schedules and high-stakes technical dependencies.
- Strong communication and leadership skills, able to drive alignment across engineering, operations, and leadership stakeholders without direct authority.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving instincts; comfortable digging into technical details to understand blockers and drive resolution.
- Experience supporting silicon bring-up and post-silicon validation environments is highly desirable.
